recentItems.title: NCC Then vs Now: 18 Years Apart
recentItems.description:
From lifelong friendships to discovering their passion and learning to lead, NCC has left its mark on generations of cadets.

For NCC's 125th anniversary, MAJ Brandon Lim and Cadet Captain Muhammad Raiyaan Arshad look back on their NCC journeys 18 years apart, and share the experiences that have stayed with them.

Here's to 125 years of NCC and the generations of cadets who continue its legacy. 🎖️

recentItems.title: Got What It Takes to Be an SAF Specialist? 👀 | TRUTH OR CAP
recentItems.description:
Failed his first IPPT. Five months later? Gold 🫡

Now a Golden Bayonet recipient, 3SG Samuel Ng looks back on his journey through the Specialist Cadet Course and puts some assumptions about the course to the test.

Truth or Cap? Let’s find out. 🧢

recentItems.title: Defence Scholarship Awards 2026 - “Dear Future Me”
recentItems.description: Defence scholarship recipients LTA Aryan Vinayak Gupta and ME4T Joy Choo Le Xuan share a little note to their future selves. 💌 20 years from now, will they still remember what brought them here?

recentItems.title: Defending Our Home, Celebrating Our Nation
recentItems.description: What brings us together as Singaporeans? 🇸🇬 From shared pride to a renewed commitment to our nation, catch the highlights from MINDEF’s National Day Observance Ceremony.

recentItems.title: The Call Up Ep 4: Different Uniforms, Same Brotherhood
recentItems.description:
Some of the strongest friendships are forged through shared experiences.

From training together to supporting one another through challenges, hear how NS creates bonds that often last well beyond ORD. @TotalDefenceSG
